sections.title: Libraries under terms that are not free software licenses
sections.body:
Google ML Kit GenAI Prompt API (com.google.mlkit), used for Gemini Nano answers on devices that provide it.
Terms: ML Kit Terms of Service, https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/terms
ML Kit's own third-party notices are packaged with the app under META-INF/third_party_licenses/.

Google Play services base, basement and tasks libraries (com.google.android.gms), which ML Kit brings with it.
Terms: Android Software Development Kit License, https://developer.android.com/studio/terms.html

Garmin Connect IQ companion app SDK (com.garmin.connectiq), used for the Garmin watch link.
Terms: Garmin's Connect IQ SDK License Agreement and Connect IQ Application Developer Agreement, https://developer.garmin.com/connect-iq/sdk/

sections.title: Offline speech recognition
sections.body:
Vosk Android 0.3.75, including its native library libvosk.so, by Alpha Cephei Inc. License: Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api
Vosk's native library is built from other speech projects as well; see the Vosk source for their notices.

Wake model vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15, Copyright 2020 Alpha Cephei Inc. License: Apache-2.0.
Bundled with the app as signal-station/wake-model.zip.
Model catalog: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
SHA-256: 30f26242c4eb449f948e42cb302dd7a686cb29a3423a8367f99ff41780942498

Java Native Access (JNA) 5.18.1, including libjnidispatch.so, a dependency of Vosk. Offered under LGPL-2.1-or-later or Apache-2.0; used here under Apache-2.0.
Source: https://github.com/java-native-access/jna

sections.title: On-device model runtime
sections.body:
LiteRT-LM 0.17.0 (com.google.ai.edge.litertlm), including liblitertlm_jni.so, used for Gemma answers on the device. License: Apache-2.0.

No Gemma model file is bundled. The app downloads or imports one only when you ask, and that file has its own terms: see the model page it is downloaded from.

sections.title: Bundled data
sections.body:

Protocol Buffers runtime, repackaged inside androidx.datastore:datastore-preferences-external-protobuf and androidx.health.connect:connect-client-external-protobuf. Copyright 2008 Google Inc. License: BSD-3-Clause.

sections.title: What is not in the app
sections.body: The app contains no Core Devices code. It talks to a Pebble through the separately installed Pebble app, over PebbleKit Android 2 (Apache-2.0). Weather, place and model providers are network services, not bundled software.
